meaning_zh: n.（常用于录写正式文件的）纸卷,书卷，画卷，卷轴,涡卷形（装饰）,〈古〉表，目录
vt.使成卷形,（电脑屏幕上）从上到下移动（资料等），卷页
vi.（似卷轴般）卷起,（像展开卷轴般地）将文字显示于屏幕
example_en: Scroll tells also about power full guardians which can be created by using that artifact.
example_zh: 卷轴还提到了用这块石头创造的强大的卫兵.

example_en: The old man is a scrooge.
example_zh: 那个老人是个守财奴.

meaning_zh: vt.压,挤压,扭曲（面部）,把…揉成小团
example_en: I scrunch up my nose at the sight of ( table ) scrap in the garbage.
example_zh: 残羹 剩菜使我掩鼻.

meaning_zh: n.良心上的不安,顾虑，顾忌
example_en: He acted wrongly and without scruple.
example_zh: 他做了错事毫不内疚.

meaning_zh: adj.严谨的,小心的,良心不安的,有顾忌的
example_en: Choosing a foundation of right of claim is a scientific and scrupulous legal intellection process.
example_zh: 请求权基础之选择是一个科学、严谨的法律思维过程.

meaning_zh: adv.一丝不苟地,小心翼翼地，多顾虑地
example_en: Each dress is hemmed and scrupulously checked for imperfections.
example_zh: 每条连衣裙都缝上了褶边，并经过严格的检查，不允许有任何瑕疵。

example_en: We scrutinize the crime scene, collect the evidence recreate what happened without ever having been there.
example_zh: 我们仔细检查犯罪现场, 收集证据并重建犯罪过程.

meaning_zh: n.细看，细阅,仔细的观察,监督
example_en: Elected officials must reelection at periodic intervals, when their record is subject to intensive public scrutiny.
example_zh: 选举产生的官员必须定期接受改选, 届时其业绩要受到彻底的公开审查.

meaning_zh: n.水肺，便携式水下呼吸器
example_en: My hobbies were skiing and scuba diving.
example_zh: 我爱好滑雪和潜水。

meaning_zh: n.扭打，混战,拖脚行走，拖步,拖着脚走的声音
example_en: The drunken men started to scuffle.
example_zh: 这一群喝醉的人开始混战.

example_en: Then, sculpt the remaining fringe parting.
example_zh: 然后, 雕刻剩余的边缘分别.

example_en: Not a word on why Scum could nt break us down.
example_zh: 别把斯卡姆打不到我们的原因说出去.

meaning_zh: adj.满是浮渣的，浮渣般的，下流的
example_en: I don't like walking through the scummy part of town.
example_zh: 我不喜欢走过城里的下层居民区.

meaning_zh: vi.急匆匆地走,使急赶,催促
example_en: Like worker ants they rush around and scurry as if the world is at an end.
example_zh: 象工作者蚂蚁他们冲和疾走好象世界是在末端.

example_en: A, such as scurvy, beriberi, or, caused by deficiency of one or more essential vitamins.
example_zh: 一种存在于新鲜水果(尤其是柑桔类水果)和蔬菜中的维生素;防止坏血病.

meaning_zh: vt.破坏（计划），毁坏,（在船底凿孔）使船沉没，凿沉
vi.快跑，急走,逃避，急忙撤退
example_en: Twice he brought in his walking stick, and once he brought in the coal scuttle.
example_zh: 有两次他把他的拐杖带进去, 而有一次他带进去一个媒斗.

example_en: He was very busy, putting an edge on a scythe.
example_zh: 他正忙着干活, 在磨一把长柄大镰刀的刃儿.

example_en: He had sole jurisdiction in maritime and seafaring causes.
example_zh: 他对海商案件拥有专属管辖权.

meaning_zh: v.密封( seal的过去式和过去分词 ),决定,确定,封上（信封）
example_en: The areas are sealed off and ringed by troops.
example_zh: 这些地区被军队封锁包围了。

meaning_zh: n.接缝，接合处,煤层,线缝,裂缝
example_en: The seam of his coat is pulled.
example_zh: 他外套的线缝被撕开了.

meaning_zh: n.女裁缝，做针线活的妇女
example_en: The supposed Evremonde descends, and the seamstress is lifted out next after him.
example_zh: 被当作是埃佛瑞蒙德的人下了车, 女裁缝也跟着被扶了下来.
